$comment: Performance budgets. perf.mjs compares against these. p95 allows normal vsync jitter at 60Hz; a dropped frame shows up as ~33ms. Tighten after the lab; never loosen without an ADR.

headless_frame.$comment: CI-only thresholds for software-rendered headless Chromium. ~2× real-device due to lack of GPU. Used for regression detection (relative), not absolute truth. Baseline measured at p95≈105ms on CI runner (2026-10-16); 120ms gives ~14% headroom.
